title: Launch HN: BitBoard (YC P25) – Analytics Workspace for Agents
summary: BitBoard is a YC P25-backed agentic analytics workspace that enables both humans and AI agents to collaborate on live data dashboards, providing persistent infrastructure for AI-driven data analysis that was previously ephemeral and hard to share.
problem_solved: AI tools treat data analysis as temporary and ephemeral, making it difficult to create persistent reports or enable collaboration between humans and AI agents.
why_valuable: It bridges the gap between ephemeral AI analysis and production-grade reporting by providing a shared workspace where agents and humans can collaborate on live dashboards in real-time.
